info.title: Ytter API
info.description: API with role-based access control. Roles: 'admin', 'host', and 'client'.

get.description: Handle Google OAuth callback. Creates or links user account and returns tokens.
Initiate Google OAuth flow. Returns the Google OAuth URL to redirect the user to.

post.description: Use this API to login user
Use this API to refresh access token. Public endpoint - validates refresh token from request body (not Bearer header).
Use this API to create a new user

get.description: Use this API to verify user's email

post.description: Confirm a pending booking. Idempotent when already confirmed.
Cancel pending or confirmed booking for an owned location; ignores customer cancellation window.
Mark a confirmed booking as no-show, or clear no-show back to confirmed. Slot capacity is unchanged.
Cancel a pending booking and release slot capacity.

get.description: Locations owned by the host (or all locations for admin). Includes booking policy fields.

post.description: Create a location owned by the authenticated host.

get.description: Get one host-owned location by slug.

patch.description: Update fields on a host-owned location.

get.description: Return fill rate, cancellation rate, pending aging, and no-show proxy.
Bookings for one location with optional status and date filters.
Services for one location with optional active filter.

post.description: Create a service for an owned location.

patch.description: Update fields on a location service.

get.description: Slots for one location with optional status/date/resource filters.

post.description: Create a slot for an owned location.
Create multiple slots for one location from recurring pattern.

patch.description: Update fields on a location slot.

get.description: Get one host-owned location by id.
Derived setup progress for location/service/slot prerequisites.
List bookings linked to the authenticated client account.

post.description: Cancel an authenticated client's own booking within policy window.

get.description: Fetch location/service context to prefill rebook flow for an owned booking.

post.description: Create guest booking for a location slot.
Guest cancellation by booking id and cancel token.

get.description: List active locations available for public booking.
Public service/practitioner/room filters for a location.
Public location slot discovery with filters and pagination.

post.description: Join waitlist for an unavailable slot.

patch.description: Update user. Roles: admin, host & client
